text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, at Tazuna's request, I deliver
some
handouts to Agnes Tachyon on the
way back to
my office.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...
Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Tachyon! Tachyon! Wake up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Do you need Tachyon for something
too?
That's too bad. Take a look at her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Heh-heh! Hey now, don't fight... All students are my guinea pigs, so just line up and play nice... Heh-heh. Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And after I came all the way over
here to
play with her. This is so boring!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hold on. What's this? She left her
computer
on...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! This is a recipe for medicine.
Whoa...
It's supposed to help bones
heal!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that's what it says. You just have
to read
it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this is actually pretty neat! It
reminds me of
a magic potion I saw in a
grimoire once.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's make the medicine while
she's
sleeping! ♪ That'll be a great way
to kill time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, why not?! It's her fault for being
asleep! If
she doesn't want me to use her
stuff, she should
just wake up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A little concerned, I decide to stay and
keep an
eye on her while Sweep Tosho
quickly mixes up
the medicine.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
La di da! La la laaa! ♪ Now I just turn up
the heat,
and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're so annoying, Familiar. The recipe
said this
would happen.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it's a sign of success! See,
the color is
changing! ♪ Now it just
needs to boil for ten
more minutes and
it'll be ready!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Nnng... What's that smell?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally up. I can't believe how
lazy you
are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is this... Did you make this without
asking?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! And it's already done, so
there's no
point in whining now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... No, it's fine. I don't mind
at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm rather impressed! It's
splendid!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The recipe for this medicine is perfect,
but it is
quite difficult to follow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The necessary temperatures and such
are quite
delicate, and... Well, simply
put, it's difficult to
produce in large
quantities!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You've really helped me out. After
working on it
for three days and three
nights, I've been quite
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you were sleeping? Man,
you must
really love science.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But is it really all that delicate? I
thought it was
suuuper easy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But is it really all that delicate? I
thought it was
suuuper easy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You really are. I knew you were skilled,
but I
wouldn't have guessed you would
finish it so
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As a matter of fact, would you mind
helping me
make more? I would be
delighted to borrow your
powerful
magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My magic is really powerful, huh?! Hehe.
Well, I
suppooose I can help!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But let's talk about payment. I want
some of the
medicine, plus the usual tea
and snacks! The
sweet ones!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You have yourself a deal! All right, shall
we get
started?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with you?! Are you doubting my
magic? Of
course I did it right! That's a
given!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! If you don't believe me, I'll prove
it by
having you test it first!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's a great idea! Right, down the
hatch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Waaait! Don't think you're getting
out of
this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: AHAHAHA!
